entry.en: Your passport must be valid at least 3 months after you plan to leave Moldova and have at least one blank page.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 3 meses después de su salida prevista de Moldavia y tener al menos una página en blanco.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave Moldova, and at least one blank page.

entry.en: You must be able to show a return or onward flight ticket.
entry.es: Debe poder mostrar un billete de vuelo de regreso o de continuación.
entry.quote: You must be able to show a return or onward flight ticket.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared on entry.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viajero por valor de 10.000 euros o más deben declararse al entrar.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: Entering Transnistria requires filling in 2 copies of a migration card, one of which you keep to show when you leave.
entry.es: Para entrar en Transnistria hay que rellenar 2 copias de una tarjeta de migración y conservar una para mostrarla al salir.
entry.quote: When you enter Transnistria, you need to fill in 2 copies of a migration card for the de facto authorities – keep one copy to show them when you leave.

entry.en: Permission from the Department of Monuments is needed to take artwork or antiques out of Moldova.
entry.es: Se necesita permiso del Departamento de Monumentos para sacar obras de arte o antigüedades de Moldavia.
entry.quote: You must get permission from the Moldovan Department of Monuments to take any artwork or antiques out of the country.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to Transnistria, which is outside the control of the Moldovan government.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a Transnistria, que está fuera del control del gobierno moldavo.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to Transnistria.

safety.en: There have been regular political demonstrations in central Chisinau, and travellers should stay away from them.
safety.es: Ha habido manifestaciones políticas regulares en el centro de Chisinau y se debe evitarlas.
safety.quote: Stay away from all political demonstrations.

safety.en: Street crime and petty theft are a risk, particularly in Chisinau, along with pickpockets and card or ATM fraud.
safety.es: El crimen callejero y los hurtos son un riesgo, sobre todo en Chisinau, además de carteristas y fraude con tarjetas o cajeros.
safety.quote: street crime and petty theft, particularly in Chisinau

safety.en: Streets and pavements are not well-maintained or well-lit, so consider carrying a torch.
safety.es: Las calles y aceras no están bien mantenidas ni iluminadas; considere llevar una linterna.
safety.quote: Streets, pavements and public paths are not well-maintained or well-lit, including in Chisinau and other cities. Consider carrying a torch.

safety.en: Police checks are frequent and you should carry a copy of your passport photo page.
safety.es: Los controles policiales son frecuentes y debe llevar una copia de la página de foto del pasaporte.
safety.quote: There are frequent police checks and police officers have the right to ask for ID on the street. Always carry a copy of the photo page of your passport with you.

safety.en: Even small quantities of illegal drugs carry severe penalties, including long jail sentences and heavy fines.
safety.es: Incluso pequeñas cantidades de drogas ilegales conllevan penas severas, con largas condenas de cárcel y multas elevadas.
safety.quote: You should expect a long jail sentence and heavy fines for possessing, using or smuggling illegal drugs

health.en: Only drink bottled or boiled water.
health.es: Beba solo agua embotellada o hervida.
health.quote: Only drink bottled or boiled water.

health.en: State medical facilities are generally poor, while private clinics and hospitals offer better care.
health.es: Los centros médicos estatales suelen ser deficientes, mientras que las clínicas y hospitales privados ofrecen mejor atención.
health.quote: State medical facilities in Moldova are generally poor. Private clinics and hospitals offer a better standard of care.

health.en: Providers expect cash or card payment at the time of treatment, so have travel health insurance and accessible funds.
health.es: Los proveedores esperan pago en efectivo o con tarjeta en el momento del tratamiento; tenga seguro médico de viaje y fondos accesibles.
health.quote: Most medical service providers in Moldova will expect cash or card payment for their services at the time of treatment.

health.en: Health risks include biting insects and ticks, and tick-borne encephalitis.
health.es: Entre los riesgos para la salud figuran los insectos picadores, las garrapatas y la encefalitis transmitida por garrapatas.
health.quote:
biting insects and ticks

- tick-borne encephalitis

health.en: Ambulance staff may only speak Russian or Romanian.
health.es: El personal de ambulancias puede hablar solo ruso o rumano.
health.quote: Staff may only speak Russian or Romanian.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

getting_in.en: The main international airport is Chișinău International Airport (RMO).
getting_in.es: El principal aeropuerto internacional es el Aeropuerto Internacional de Chișinău (RMO).
getting_in.quote: The main international airport is 1 Chișinău International Airport (RMO IATA).

getting_in.en: Wizz Air, HiSky and Fly One serve several destinations from Chisinau.
getting_in.es: Wizz Air, HiSky y Fly One operan varios destinos desde Chisinau.
getting_in.quote: Airlines that serve several destinations from Chisinau are Wizz Air, HiSky and Fly One

getting_in.en: Daily overnight trains run from Romania.
getting_in.es: Hay trenes nocturnos diarios desde Rumanía.
getting_in.quote: There are daily trains from Romania.

getting_in.en: There are 5-6 buses per day to and from Bucharest, taking around 10 hours.
getting_in.es: Hay 5-6 autobuses diarios desde y hacia Bucarest, con un viaje de unas 10 horas.
getting_in.quote: There are 5-6 buses per day to and from Bucharest. Due to a longer stay at the border the trip takes around 10 hours.

getting_in.en: Some buses from Odesa go through Tiraspol in Transnistria, while others go around.
getting_in.es: Algunos autobuses desde Odesa pasan por Tiraspol, en Transnistria, y otros la rodean.
getting_in.quote: Some buses from Odesa go through Tiraspol, while others go around

getting_around.en: The most reliable way of getting around the country is by bus.
getting_around.es: La forma más fiable de moverse por el país es en autobús.
getting_around.quote: The most reliable way of getting around the country is by bus.

getting_around.en: Chișinău is the main transportation hub, with three bus stations serving every city and town.
getting_around.es: Chișinău es el principal centro de transporte, con tres estaciones de autobuses que sirven a todas las ciudades y pueblos.
getting_around.quote: Chișinău is the main transportation hub for the country. The three bus stations serve every city and town in Moldova.

getting_around.en: Small minibuses are the fastest form of transport, while larger buses are marginally safer because they travel slower.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses pequeños son el transporte más rápido, y los autobuses grandes son algo más seguros por ir más lentos.
getting_around.quote: The fastest form of transport are small minibuses which seat around 15 people.

getting_around.en: The Chișinău trolleybus fare is 6 lei, collected by a conductor.
getting_around.es: La tarifa del trolebús de Chișinău es de 6 lei, cobrada por un cobrador.
getting_around.quote: Fare is 6 lei; a conductor collects fares and issues tickets.

getting_around.en: Minibuses (rutiere) are paid on boarding, 3 lei in Chișinău, and can be very crowded.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses (rutiere) se pagan al subir, 3 lei en Chișinău, y pueden ir muy llenos.
getting_around.quote: Drivers should be paid on boarding (3 lei in Chișinău)

money.en: Card payment is widespread but not always possible, particularly outside Chisinau.
money.es: El pago con tarjeta está extendido pero no siempre es posible, sobre todo fuera de Chisinau.
money.quote: Paying by card is now generally widespread, however you may not always be able to pay this way, particularly outside the capital, Chisinau.

money.en: US dollars and euros are the most widely accepted foreign currencies, and notes should be in perfect condition.
money.es: Los dólares y euros son las divisas extranjeras más aceptadas, y los billetes deben estar en perfecto estado.
money.quote: The most widely accepted foreign currencies are US dollars and euros. Carry some euros in cash.

money.en: Notes should be in perfect condition or they may be refused.
money.es: Los billetes deben estar en perfecto estado o pueden ser rechazados.
money.quote: Notes should be in perfect condition, or they may be refused.

money.en: In Transnistria, ATMs will not accept cards from non-Transnistrian banks and paying in currencies other than the ruble is considered illegal.
money.es: En Transnistria, los cajeros no aceptan tarjetas de bancos no transnistrios y pagar en otras monedas que el rublo se considera ilegal.
money.quote: ATMs in Transnistrian banks will not accept cards from non-Transnistrian banks.

money.en: Wikivoyage says the currency is the leu (plural lei), and that Moldovans are not accustomed to tipping.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que la moneda es el leu (plural lei) y que los moldavos no están acostumbrados a dar propina.
money.quote: Moldovans are not accustomed to tipping.

etiquette.en: Conservative dress is expected at religious sites: shorts are forbidden and women must cover their heads in monasteries and churches.
etiquette.es: Se espera vestimenta conservadora en sitios religiosos: no se permiten pantalones cortos y las mujeres deben cubrirse la cabeza en monasterios e iglesias.
etiquette.quote: Conservative dress must be worn at religious sites. Shorts are forbidden and women must cover their heads inside monasteries and churches.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage advises avoiding the Transnistria conflict as a topic, as it can be very sensitive.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage aconseja evitar el conflicto de Transnistria como tema, pues puede ser muy delicado.
etiquette.quote: Avoid bringing up the Transnistria conflict; it can be a very sensitive topic of discussion

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says identity and language are sensitive, with some calling the official language Romanian and others Moldovan.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage dice que la identidad y el idioma son temas delicados: unos llaman rumano al idioma oficial y otros moldavo.
etiquette.quote: Identity can be a highly sensitive issue in Moldova; most identify as "Moldovan", while some identify as "Romanian"

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says staring from locals indicates curiosity rather than hostility.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage dice que las miradas de los locales indican curiosidad y no hostilidad.
etiquette.quote: Tourists are likely to attract stares from the locals. Do not be alarmed or surprised; this doesn't indicate hostility, but rather, curiosity.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says women are traditionally treated with chivalry, such as men paying bills and opening doors.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage dice que las mujeres reciben tradicionalmente un trato caballeroso, como que los hombres paguen la cuenta y abran puertas.
etiquette.quote: women are traditionally treated with chivalry in Moldova.
